quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #14
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street going the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass, even on a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass, even on a green light.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. Drivers must wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning left.

questions.question: If a vehicle's high beams are coming toward you, where should you look?
questions.correctAnswerText: The right side
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road. This prevents the bright lights from blinding you and helps you stay on the road until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zones.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones. The sign will also have text to confirm this.

questions.question: Which of these must you obey first?
questions.correctAnswerText: A police officer
questions.explanation: A police officer's directions take priority over all signs, signals, and road markings. This includes police officers, fire police, highway work zone flag persons, and school crossing guards.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp right turn is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a sharp right turn coming up on the road.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed when conditions are normal.
The maximum safe speed in all weather and road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed when conditions are normal.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road under normal conditions. You may need to drive slower if weather or road conditions are not ideal.

questions.question: When two vehicles reach an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The car approaching from the right.
The car approaching from the left.
The car whose driver honks first.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car approaching from the right.
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no traffic control signs or signals, you must yield to a vehicle coming from your right.

questions.question: What should you do if your vehicle's right wheels leave the pavement?

options.text: Pull completely off the road and get back on when it is safe.
Speed up and steer back onto the road quickly.
Release the accelerator, slow down, then carefully steer back onto the road when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Release the accelerator, slow down, then carefully steer back onto the road when safe.
questions.explanation: Stay calm. Take your foot off the accelerator and steer parallel to the road. Slow down and ease back onto the road with a gentle turn of the steering wheel. Keep both hands on the wheel and check for traffic before returning to the pavement.

questions.question: What does a single dashed white line between lanes mean?

options.text: You may pass even if it is dangerous.
Lanes are moving in opposite directions.
You may pass if it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: White dashed lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. You can cross a dashed white line to pass or change lanes when it is safe.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spot before changing lanes?

options.text: Look in the left side mirror.
Look in the right side mirror.
Look over your shoulder toward the direction you plan to move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder toward the direction you plan to move.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move to check your blind spot before changing lanes.

questions.question: A bicyclist who doesn't obey traffic laws:

options.text: Is allowed to break traffic laws.
Will always get a warning from police.
Will have their bicycle taken away.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can be ticketed.
questions.explanation: Bicyclists have the same rights and responsibilities as car drivers. Both can be ticketed for breaking traffic laws.

questions.question: Double solid yellow lines in the middle of the road mean:

options.text: You cannot pass from either direction.
You can pass from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot pass from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing is allowed from either direction. You may only cross these lines to turn left or to pass pedestrians, bicyclists, or scooter riders when the other lane is clear.

questions.question: What is the most common cause of traffic crashes?
questions.correctAnswerText: Human error
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers don't see other vehicles or do something unexpected. Talk to other drivers on the road to prevent crashes.

questions.question: Drivers must yield to a pedestrian:

options.text: Even if the pedestrian crosses carelessly.
Only when the pedestrian is in a crosswalk.
Only if the pedestrian is on the same side of the road.
If the pedestrian signals you to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Even if the pedestrian crosses carelessly.
questions.explanation: Drivers must always yield to pedestrians in the street, even if they are crossing against a red light or being careless.

questions.question: Distracted driving is:

options.text: No more dangerous than normal driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Extremely risky.
questions.explanation: Distracted driving is extremely risky and dangerous for you, your passengers, and everyone on the road. Paying attention while driving helps prevent crashes.

questions.question: If someone has drunk alcohol, what will help them recover from its effects?
questions.correctAnswerText: Only time
questions.explanation: Only time will allow a person to recover from alcohol's effects.

questions.question: If your vehicle starts to skid, you should:

options.text: Turn your steering wheel toward traffic.
Turn your steering wheel in the direction of the skid.
Let go of the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel in the direction of the skid.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, stay calm. Steer in the direction the vehicle is skidding.

questions.question: Which light tells you to slow down and be careful at an intersection?
questions.correctAnswerText: A flashing yellow light
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you must slow down, be careful, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: You may drink alcohol in a vehicle on a public road:

options.text: As long as you are not driving.
If you are in the back seat.
If you are in the back of a pickup truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never.
questions.explanation: You cannot drink or carry open alcohol in a vehicle on a public road. It is also illegal to store open alcohol in areas where the driver or passengers sit.

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway:

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
You don't need to use your turn signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check that the passing lane is clear and use your turn signal to show other drivers you are changing lanes.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ and must always be obeyed.
questions.correctAnswerText: White
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic. They are white with black markings. Drivers must always obey them.

questions.question: Roads freeze quickly when they are:
questions.correctAnswerText: Shaded.
questions.explanation: Shaded areas under trees or buildings freeze faster in cold or wet weather. These spots are the last to dry. Drive with extra care in shaded areas.

questions.question: If an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches you on a one-way street, you must:

options.text: Drive with your flashers turned on.
Drive to the nearest roadside and stop.
Speed up and take the nearest exit.
Slow down until the vehicle passes you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the nearest roadside and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with lights or siren approaches on a one-way street, drive to the nearest roadside and stop.

questions.question: You should honk your horn when you:

options.text: See a child about to run into the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: See a child about to run into the street.
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn drivers or pedestrians who may not see you. For example, honk if a child is running into the street in front of your vehicle.

questions.question: Before your driver or nondriver license expires, the Driver License Bureau will mail a renewal reminder to:

options.text: The most current address on your driver record.
The address on your last application.
The address in your local phone book.

questions.correctAnswerText: The most current address on your driver record.
questions.explanation: The bureau mails renewal reminders to the address on your driver record. No reminder is sent for temporary instruction permits or commercial learner's permits.
